quarterly_data.signal: Lam's fiscal 2026 10-K shows leading- and non-leading-edge equipment and upgrade revenue by market of Foundry 54%, Memory 39% and Logic/integrated device manufacturing 7%, versus 45%, 42% and 13% in fiscal 2025 and 40%, 42% and 18% in fiscal 2024. The Foundry share increased 900 basis points on mature node spending and investments in leading-edge equipment, while Memory decreased 300 basis points primarily due to timing of customer investments. Fiscal 2026 capital expenditures were $966.4 million, with the higher investing outflow attributed to lab investments in the United States and global growth in manufacturing facilities. Lam also says it issues purchase orders based on estimates of its production needs, many times well in advance of delivery dates; these open purchase orders are not included in its off-balance sheet commitments, and as of June 28, 2026 it expects to fulfill approximately $727.9 million within one year related to these arrangements.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 Foundry 54% / Memory 39% / Logic-IDM 7% (FY2025 45% / 42% / 13%); capex $966.4 million; ~$727.9 million of production-need purchase orders expected to be fulfilled within one year (as of June 28, 2026)
